item.title: Gurney exits World Darts Championship after defeat to Callan Rydz
item.description: Daryl Gurney has been knocked out of the 2026 PDC World Darts Championship at the 2nd Round Stage this afternoon. The Derry native was beaten 3 sets to 2 by Callan Rydz after a nail-biting last-leg play-off at Alexandra Palace in London. Antrim’s Josh Rock plays Joe Comito tonight for place in Round 3. item.title: Six routes to be gritted tomorrow morning
item.description: Six of the routes on Donegal County Council’s Winter Programme will be gritted from 6 o’clock tomorrow morning, with temperatures predicted to fall below freezing in western parts of the county tonight. The routes are Killult East and West, The Rosses, Stranorlar West, and Donegal West and North.
